description: This file defines the HoverHUDController class responsible for managing a hover-only heads-up display (HUD) anchored to the menu bar item in a macOS application. It includes methods for presenting, dismissing, and updating the HUD, as well as handling hover states and interactions. The file also contains the SwiftUI view HoverHUDView which displays status information and responds to user interactions.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: A controller class managing the lifecycle, presentation, and interactions of a hover HUD in a macOS app, with internal state modeling and UI presentation logic.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets whether the HUD presentation is suppressed, cancelling tasks and dismissing if needed.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state changes over the status item, initiating show or dismiss tasks with delay.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Updates hover state over the panel and schedules dismiss if hover ends.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the chat panel using the provided anchor point.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the HUD, optionally with a reason, animating out if visible.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules a dismiss action after a delay unless hover resumes.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Prepares and displays the HUD window at the target position.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the window and sets up the hosting view if not already done.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the target frame for the HUD based on anchor point or default position.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates window frame with optional animation.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Installs a global event monitor to detect outside clicks for dismiss.

methods.name: removeDismissMonitor
methods.description: Removes the global event monitor for outside clicks.
